name: Hidden Villa Farm Field Trip
description: Explore animal habitats, how animals adapt to their environment, and how they help it thrive. PARENTS: Return the permission slip sent home in the white envelope ASAP. Sign up to chaperone using the Google Doc link.

name: Valentine's Day Celebration
description: PARENTS: Bring 1 Valentine's card for each of the 22 students in the class. Leave the 'To:' section blank. Keep goodies and prizes small.

name: Pajama Day Spirit Day
description: Students can wear their favorite pajamas to school.

name: Sports Shirt Spirit Day
description: PARENTS: Send your child to school wearing a sports-themed shirt.

name: Label New Items
description: PARENTS: Label your child's new clothing, jackets, and other items with their name for easier identification.

name: Variety Show
description: Come show us what you've got! Sing, Rap, Dance, Lip Sync, Magic, Musical Instrument, Cheer Performance, Skit, Monologue, Jump Rope, Yo Yo, Puppet show, Comedy Routine, Impressions, Mime, Martial Arts demo, Poetry, Baton twirling.

name: NOWRUZ (IRANIAN NEW YEAR) STAFF LUNCHEON
description: Please join us as we treat our staff to a delicious luncheon to celebrate the upcoming Iranian New Year and the first day of spring! Please sign up to bring a dish HERE!

name: Variety Show Dress Rehearsal
description: Dress rehearsal for the Variety Show.

name: Family Fun Night at BJ's
description: Show this flyer for dine-in and take-out and enter code MAR580 for online orders, and 20% will go to the PTA!

name: Pioneer High School Athletics 2026 Crab Feed
description: Come hungry (and thirsty!) to the all-you-can-eat + all-you-can-drink night that keeps the fun (and the cracking!) going.

name: Multicultural Fair
description: A beloved tradition at this school, we once again invite you to share your culture with us, whether it's helping with your country's booth (or starting one if it isn't represented yet!), fashion show, or with a group cultural performance.

name: Astronaut Assembly
description: We had such a fun assembly this week with astronaut Steve Smith! A huge shout-out to Mary Okner for planning these awesome assemblies!

name: Variety Show Application Deadline
description: Audition Videos: Due by Sunday, March 1st, 2026

name: 5th Grade Baby Photos Deadline
description: 5th grade parents — start gathering those adorable baby photos for the 5th Grade Baby Pages! They are due by March 31st!

name: Yearbook Order Deadline
description: Order your 2025–26 Yearbook today and save all the memories. Last day to order: 4/20 — but don't wait until the last minute! We won't have extras on hand if you forget to order.

name: Volunteer for Uniform Closet Organization
description: The front office is in need of two volunteers to help organize the uniform closet during the minimum days we have in March (12th and 13th) after school.

name: Reading Lab Volunteers Needed
description: The Reading Lab is a tutoring program for students who would benefit from extra help with fundamental reading skills. We are looking for volunteers who can come in once per week (Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday) during the school year. Training for new tutors is provided!! Helping these new & growing readers is super fun and rewarding!

name: Castillero PTA Board Volunteers
description: Castillero PTA is looking for incoming 6th grade parents to serve on the board. Castillero PTA funds and/ or runs events and programs like school dances, carnival, spirit wear, teacher and staff appreciation, and teacher grants. If you are interested in getting involved, please contact Stephanie Pearson-Phillips.

name: PTA Board Volunteers Needed
description: We are looking for members of our Los Alamitos community to join our PTA Executive Board for 2026-27 school year! More details about specific positions will be shared soon, but if you're interested in getting involved, please email us or connect with any of our current board members.
